text: Bombas was co-founded by David Heath (CEO) and Randy Goldberg (President).
notes: Article published 2024-12-22. Randy Goldberg graduated from Georgetown with a finance degree per this outlet; one lower-quality search result named Babson College instead and is not trusted here.

text: Bombas is headquartered in New York City, near Union Square (37 E 18th St, 4th Floor); the office was completed in August 2017 at about 6,500 square feet.
notes: Article published 2018-02-21; a design-press feature, not a primary company statement.

text: Bombas runs on a One Purchased = One Donated model: for every item purchased, the company donates a clothing item, socks, underwear, or t-shirts, the three most-requested items at homeless shelters, to a Giving Partner serving people experiencing homelessness or housing insecurity.
notes: Company's own public impact microsite; no publish date given on the page itself, so captured_at is the date this record was written.

text: As of 2026, Bombas states customers have powered more than 200 million donations through a network of more than 4,000 Giving Partners in all 50 states.
notes: Company's own public impact microsite figure, current as of this capture.
